name: bill_of_rights
description: Retrieve the numbered U.S. Bill of Rights amendment from a fixed table of protections; matched controls retrieve calendar-month ordinals using exactly the same answer vocabulary.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
ordinals=['First','Second','Third','Fourth','Fifth','Sixth','Seventh','Eighth','Ninth','Tenth']
rights=[['freedom of speech','free exercise of religion','freedom of the press'],['the right to keep and bear arms','the protection concerning a well regulated militia','the constitutional protection of bearing arms'],['the restriction on quartering soldiers in private homes','protection against compulsory quartering of soldiers in peacetime','the rule against peacetime quartering without the owner\'s consent'],['protection against unreasonable searches and seizures','the warrant requirement of probable cause','constitutional limits on government searches'],['the privilege against compelled self-incrimination','protection against double jeopardy','just compensation for government takings of private property'],['the right to a speedy and public criminal trial','the right to confront adverse witnesses in a criminal case','the right to assistance of counsel in a criminal prosecution'],['the federal civil jury trial right in suits at common law','preservation of trial by jury in certain federal civil cases','the civil jury guarantee for common-law suits exceeding twenty dollars'],['the ban on cruel and unusual punishments','the ban on excessive bail','the ban on excessive fines'],['the protection of unenumerated rights retained by the people','the rule that enumerating some rights does not deny other retained rights','the Bill of Rights provision concerning unlisted rights'],['reservation of undelegated powers to the states or the people','the reservation of powers not delegated to the federal government','the constitutional rule on reserved powers']]
months=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October']
frames=['Which ordinal identifies {d}?\nAnswer with one ordinal word:','Identify the ordinal for {d}.\nAnswer:','The ordinal associated with {d} is']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(10):
 for j in range(3):
  for f in frames:
   items.append({'prompt':f.format(d='the U.S. constitutional amendment guaranteeing '+rights[i][j]),'answer':' '+ordinals[i]})
   descriptors=[months[i]+' in the calendar year','the month named '+months[i]+' in the annual calendar',months[i]+' among the twelve calendar months']
   control.append({'prompt':f.format(d=descriptors[j]),'answer':' '+ordinals[i]})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
